top_choice_rationale: P004 rewards a clear physical-chemical design principle: a pH-dependent ionizable lipid lets one self-assembled particle load nucleic acid, circulate near neutral and turn fusogenic in the endosome. The principle is reproduced by many groups and has already enabled approved siRNA and mRNA medicines, so maturity is demonstrated. The Vancouver trio holds the earliest encapsulation and ionizable-lipid work, and the vehicle is distinct from the cargo modification honoured in 2023. Attribution is imperfect (Anderson, Langer and MacLachlan fall outside the cut) but no better than for P001, which also needs an arbitrary split and awaits a PROTAC approval; P002 is the most mature and best attributed but refines a bond class framed by 2010.
recusal_note: My research on lipid self-assembly and lipid-protein interaction is scientifically close to the B009 lipid nanoparticle work, which may bias me toward P004; I have no personal, institutional or collaborative tie to Cullis, Hope or Madden apparent from my profile, so no recusal is clearly required.
